title: pdf_prebake main() ignores the priv-dir argument its own doc comment instructs users to pass, and exits 0 on failure
detail: Doc says the CLI arg selects the priv dir, but main hardcodes "priv" and never reads argv. Failure branch only prints "FAILED: ..." with no non-zero exit, so a scripted regeneration silently succeeds on partial output.
recommended_fix: Either read argv (gleam/erlang/ffi or argv) to honor the documented arg and halt(1) on failures, or fix the doc comment to state cwd=server/ is mandatory and the arg is unused.

title: pdf_prebake.gleam ships unused imports and an unused helper in a brand-new module
detail: GetCoApplicantsByApplicationRow, GetDocumentsByApplicationRow, GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow appear only in the import; str_opt is defined at line 54 and never called. Fresh code should not start life with compiler warnings.
recommended_fix: Delete the three unused type-only imports and the unused str_opt helper.

title: Fixture data duplicated between server pdf_prebake and client demo_fixtures with no automated consistency guard
detail: Client fixtures are pinned to shared/ decoders by fixtures_conformance_test.gleam, but nothing pins pdf_prebake's hand-copied payloads (e.g. Aoife 485_000/725_000, Finlay Digital Ltd) against the client fixtures — the downloaded PDF can silently drift from the UI story.
recommended_fix: Acceptable for static assets, but add the smallest guard: a server test asserting pdf_prebake payload ids/scores match a shared fixture manifest, or a make target that regenerates+diffs the PDFs.

title: Demo no-network CI lint only scans *.gleam imports — a network-capable .mjs FFI in demo/ would not be caught
evidence:
VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "rsvp\|api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)
...
FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)
detail: The pin is real (not vacuous) for Gleam imports, but demo_analytics_ffi.mjs already performs consent-gated PostHog network I/O outside the lint's net; any future .mjs FFI in demo/ could do the same unapproved. The lint's "fully client-side" claim overstates its coverage.
recommended_fix: Extend the lint to whitelist demo/ FFI files by name (currently only demo_analytics_ffi.mjs) and fail on any new *.mjs/*.ts under client/src/demo/.
